device.type: Compact DVB-S2 Full HD H.265/HEVC satellite receiver with Conax CA card reader, Ethernet, USB Wi-Fi and external IR/LED eye
device.soc: ALi M3521A / C3505 with 128 MB DDR3 (maincode "ALI_C3505:0x%x", seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xA6000200)

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Amiko firmware archive)
source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive Amiko_Mini_HD265_1.1.67_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB DDR3 C3505 board (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_mini_hd265_app_starts.py, run_dump_mini_hd265_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM bootloader runs in boot SRAM at 0x9FE00800, unpacks maincode(AV) (chips/base.py:maincode) to 0x80000200 and seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xA6000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x86002001).  The application drives the CH455 front panel on GPIO 107 / 110 (" ON ", " on "), initialises its 60-entry remote key table (0x60xx, "necfirst" coding) and MCAS database, and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 OSD through the display engine at 0xB8006900.

desc: Amiko Mini HD265 (System ID 6B000A00) firmware 1.1.67 EMU (2017-12-07) for the compact Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the ALi M3521A / C3505 SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.

Shares the 6B000A00 hardware platform with the Amiko HD8155: uses a "maincode(AV)" application chunk at 0x030000, a CH455 (TM1650-compatible) 4-digit LED display on GPIO 107 / 110, and the Amiko 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
